fields.label: Field Name for Values of Precipitation Rate (m/day)
fields.help: Indicate the field name for the time-varying values of precipitation rate.

fields.label: Static Value for Precipitation Rate (m/day)
fields.help: Enter a single value of precipitation rate to use throughout your model run. The default value of 0.0041 is a health-protective value resulting in constant rainfall totaling approximately 1.5 meters/year. 1.5 m/yr approximates the 95th percentile of annual average precipitation for 824 meteorological stations across the United States. This percentile was derived from 1981–2010 30-year normal values where available (for 813 stations), and otherwise from the January 1–December 31, 2016 period. 30-year normal values were from Durre et al. 2013 (NOAA's 1981-2010 U.S. Climate Normals: Monthly Precipitation, Snowfall, and Snow Depth). See the TRIM User Guide Appendix for full reference information.

fields.label: Field Name for Values of Cumulative Precipitation (m)
fields.help: Indicate the field name for the time-varying values of cumulative precipitation.

fields.label: Static Value for Cumulative Precipitation (m)
fields.help: Based on the above input of static precipitation rate.
